name: XL
recent: XL Holdings 近期出现多项企业活动：大股东兼执行主席 Ng Min Lin 在公开市场转换凭单并增持股份，公司也持续进行股份回购。同时，公司与关联方 NCSB 及 MASB 的虾苗销售经常性关联交易实际金额多次超出股东授权预估，累计超出约 95.6%。此外，公司于 9 月披露核数师因审计费用问题辞职。
notable: 执行主席 Ng Min Lin 于 2026 年 11 月 13 日行使 200 万张凭单 B，转换为 200 万股普通股。
公司于 2026 年 11 月多次进行股份回购。
公司与关联方 NCSB 及 MASB 的虾苗销售经常性关联交易实际金额超出股东授权预估上限约 95.6%。
risks: 公司核数师因审计费用问题辞职。
经常性关联交易实际金额多次超出股东授权预估，最新累计超出约 95.6%。
执行主席 Ng Min Lin 在闭市期前表示有意交易公司证券。
earnings: 2026 财年截至 7 月 31 日季度营收为 4500 万令吉，环比增长 27.1%，同比增长 151.0%；净利为 155.4 万令吉，环比下降 56.3%，同比下降 40.7%；净利率为 3.5%，低于上一季度的 10.1%。

recent_en: XL Holdings has seen several corporate activities recently: Executive Chairman Ng Min Lin converted warrants and increased his shareholding, while the company continued share buybacks. Meanwhile, actual recurrent related party transactions for shrimp post-larvae sales to NCSB and MASB repeatedly exceeded the shareholder mandate estimates, cumulatively by about 95.6%. The company also disclosed in September that its auditor resigned over audit fees.
notable_en: Executive Chairman Ng Min Lin exercised 2 million Warrants B on 13 November 2026, converting them into 2 million ordinary shares.
The company conducted multiple share buybacks in November 2026.
Actual recurrent related party transactions for shrimp post-larvae sales to NCSB and MASB exceeded the shareholder mandate estimate by about 95.6%.
risks_en: The company's auditor resigned over audit fees.
Actual recurrent related party transactions repeatedly exceeded the shareholder mandate estimate, with the latest cumulative excess at about 95.6%.
Executive Chairman Ng Min Lin gave notice of intention to deal in the company's securities during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was RM45.0 million, up 27.1% QoQ and 151.0% YoY; net income was RM1.554 million, down 56.3% QoQ and 40.7% YoY; net margin was 3.5%, lower than 10.1% in the previous quarter.
